Studydown

Focus time, clearly recorded

Studydown turns face-down time into a private focus ledger for work, learning, and daily life. Choose an Activity, start, and place your iPhone screen down.

Built for any kind of focused time

  • Face-down focus

    Time is recorded while the iPhone is face down. Pick it up to pause, then continue according to your timer settings.

  • Free: 3 Activities, 5 minutes

    Keep up to 3 Activities and 300 seconds (5 minutes) of total recorded time, with Today and This Week summaries and basic CSV. This is not a daily allowance. Lifetime Pro removes both limits; a face-down session already underway is saved without trimming.

  • Lifetime Pro

    A single lifetime unlock adds unlimited Activities, month, year, and custom analysis, weekly goals, Deadlines, Apple Watch, Widgets, advanced hero styles, and complete JSON backup and restore. No subscription.

  • Private by design

    There is no account, developer server, advertising, analytics, or tracking. App records stay on your device.

  • Also on Android

    Studydown is also available for Android, built natively for the platform, with the same free allowance (3 Activities, 5 minutes total) and a one-time Lifetime Pro purchase that unlocks unlimited Activities and recording, advanced statistics, goals, Deadlines, widgets, and backups. There is no Apple Watch companion on Android.

Contact

Tell us what happened and which device and iOS version you use. Please do not include private focus records.
